backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles with access control plus order creation, storage, and retrieval logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a checkout-to-createOrder integration to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files including pages, hooks, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and global layout rules.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML scaffold loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React root component configuring routing, authentication, profile setup, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing copyright text, heart icon, and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with navigation, cart indicator, authentication controls, and user profile display.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting first‑time users to enter their name before proceeding.
frontend/src/data/products.ts: Static product catalog defining categories, subcategories, and priced items for the store.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, logout, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles and orders through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays and manages cart items with quantity controls and navigation to checkout if authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Shows product categories and subcategories, allowing item selection and adding products to the cart.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles order submission with payment details, creates backend orders, and clears the cart upon success.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the store homepage with hero banner, server IP, Discord link, category navigation, and a floating cart button showing item count.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Fetches and displays order details with loading and error states, showing purchased items, buyer info, and UPI reference.
frontend/src/state/cart.ts: Implements a persistent Zustand cart store supporting add, remove, quantity updates, clearing, and total calculations.
frontend/src/utils/inr.ts: Provides helpers to format and parse INR currency values using the ₹ symbol.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters, including session-backed fallback handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, requirements, existing features, and architectural notes for the Aura MC store.
